parts.label: a
parts.technique: Calculate Sxy (Sth) and Sxx (Shh) as precursor to PMCC/regression
parts.reason: S2.2 excludes calculations involving regression lines and S5.1 excludes use of the PMCC formula; Sth and Shh are the summary quantities used solely to compute r and the regression line, so this falls under those exclusions.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Calculate PMCC using formula from Sxy, Sxx, Syy
parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes use of the PMCC formula (calculator value only permitted, not from summary statistics like this).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Interpret value of r to support regression
parts.reason: Depends directly on the excluded PMCC calculation in (b); interpretation of a calculated-from-formula r used to justify regression is tied to excluded material.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Find regression line equation t = a + bh
parts.reason: S2.2 explicitly excludes calculations involving regression lines.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Interpret gradient b of regression line
parts.reason: Uses the out-of-spec regression line from (d); interpretation of regression coefficients is part of the excluded regression line calculations.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Use regression line to estimate temperature difference
parts.reason: Directly uses the regression equation found in the excluded part (d).
